isolation.mode: read-only validation against the current working tree

assertionResults.reason: The tasks screen renders shared TaskRow cards whose implementation matches the contract: mist-toned bordered cards, circular 22px completion checkboxes that fill green when complete, and 8px red/amber/stone/green status dots.

references.details: TasksScreen imports and renders TaskRow for pending and completed task lists.
getPriorityColor maps the dot to success, error, warning, or stone states.
TaskRow card container uses the warm card fill with a 1px stone border.
Completion control is a circular 22x22 checkbox that fills green and shows a checkmark when complete.
Theme tokens define the mist card fill, stone border, semantic success/warning/error colors, and radius scale used by TaskRow.

assertionResults.reason: The screen does not implement a pill-style Pending/Completed segmented toggle; instead it renders three pending sections plus a separate collapsible completed section.

references.details: State derives pendingTasks and completedTasks, then further groups pending items into dueTodayTasks, thisWeekTasks, and upcomingTasks; no selected segment state exists.
Pending tasks are rendered directly under dueToday, thisWeek, and upcoming section headers rather than inside a pill segmented control.
Completed tasks are exposed through a collapsible section instead of an active primary-colored Completed segment with white text.

assertionResults.reason: The completed tasks area is collapsible, uses a chevron toggle and mist-2 pill badge for the count, and dims completed cards to 0.8 opacity when shown.

references.details: TasksScreen tracks completed section expansion with completedExpanded.
Completed section header is pressable, switches chevron direction, and renders the count badge with colors.surface[200] and borderRadius.pill.
Completed tasks render only when expanded and each wrapper applies opacity: 0.8.
Theme tokens map the count badge to mist-2 and pill radius.

summary: Validated 3 tasks assertions by read-only code review: VAL-TASKS-001 passed, VAL-TASKS-002 failed because the screen lacks the required Pending/Completed segmented toggle, and VAL-TASKS-003 passed.
